usda_cre_2015.name: USDA CNPP, Expenditures on Children by Families, 2015 (Lino, Kuczynski, Rodriguez, Schap; Misc. Pub. 1528-2015), Table 1
usda_cre_2015.note: Read from the PDF copy at https://fns-prod.azureedge.us/sites/default/files/crc2015_March2017.pdf. Latest edition found; the series has no newer edition. Married-couple families, overall US, 2015 dollars, 2011-15 Consumer Expenditure Survey. Younger child in a two-child family; only child x1.27, each child in a family of three or more x0.76. Excludes college and costs after age 17.

fred_cpiaucns.name: FRED CPIAUCNS (CPI-U, not seasonally adjusted)
fred_cpiaucns.note: 2015 monthly mean 237.017 (computed from the twelve values); October 2026 = 337.511. Used only to restate USDA 2015 dollars.

collegeboard_2026.name: College Board, Trends in College Pricing and Student Aid 2026 (2026-27 total student budgets and net prices)
collegeboard_2026.note: The highlights page lists 2026-27 tuition and fees (in-state $12,290, out-of-state $32,730, private nonprofit $46,350) but not room and board. Total budgets (tuition, fees, housing and food, books, transportation, personal) and net prices come from news summaries of the report (Washington Post 2026-11-05, Inside Higher Ed 2026-11-06, via search); the College Board page for 2026-27 totals could not be opened. The official 2025-26 totals ($30,990 in-state, $50,920 out-of-state, $65,470 private; newsroom.collegeboard.org, 2025-11-06) were read directly.

carescout_2025.name: CareScout (Genworth) 2025 Cost of Care Survey, national medians
carescout_2025.note: Data collected July-November 2025. Homemaker and home health aide are now one 'non-medical caregiver' line, $35 an hour, 44 hours a week.

acl_ltc.name: Administration for Community Living, How Much Care Will You Need?
acl_ltc.note: People turning 65: women need care 3.7 years on average, men 2.2; 20% will need more than 5 years. ACLI's guide gives 3.2 and 2.3.

rover_2025.name: Rover, The True Cost of Pet Parenthood 2025 (US)
rover_2025.note: Rover's page returned 403, so figures come from Fox 13 (2025-03-19; lifetime $34,550 dog over 10 years, $32,170 cat over 16 years) and Review42 (routine annual cost $1,390-$5,295 dog, $760-$3,495 cat). Survey of 1,000 US pet parents, Feb 2025. A commercial survey, not an audit.

banfield_frontiers_2023.name: Montoya et al., Life expectancy tables for dogs and cats derived from clinical data, Frontiers in Veterinary Science (2023)
banfield_frontiers_2023.note: Banfield US clinic records 2013-2019. Life expectancy at birth: dogs 12.69 years (giant breeds 9.51), cats 11.18 (male cats 10.72). Median survival time: dogs 14.13, cats 15.7. Read from the PDF; the by-age tables were not extracted, so remaining life is approximated as expectancy at birth minus age.

zillow_closing.name: Zillow, closing costs guide
zillow_closing.note: Buyer closing costs 2% to 5% of the purchase price (from a search summary; the page returned 403). Moving costs not sourced.

theknot_2026.name: The Knot 2026 Real Weddings Study (couples married in 2025; 10,474 couples)
theknot_2026.note: Average ceremony and reception cost $34,200 (excludes the engagement ring). The quartile points ($12,000 and $41,000) come from a secondary summary (walnutinvest.com) and the page returned 403, so they are low confidence.

nolo_divorce.name: Martindale-Nolo reader survey (2019), as reported by SoFi and others
nolo_divorce.note: Average legal bill $11,300 with a lawyer (median $7,000); uncontested with lawyers about $4,100; contested to trial about $23,300 or more. Self-selected readers, 2019 dollars (not inflated here, so slightly understated). Reported by search summaries; the survey itself was not opened.

cms_oopm_2027.name: CMS 2027 maximum annual limitation on cost sharing (PAPI guidance, 2026-01-29), as summarized by Milliman
cms_oopm_2027.note: Self-only $12,000, family $24,000 (2026: $10,600 and $21,200). In-network, essential benefits only. A ceiling, not an average bill; premiums excluded.

bls_duration.name: BLS Employment Situation, Table A-12 (duration of unemployment, seasonally adjusted)
bls_duration.note: Median 11.9 weeks, mean 27.1 weeks. Used as months of lost income for a job loss; 12 months is our illustrative high, not a BLS figure.

assumptions.dollars: Today's dollars. We restate USDA 2015 dollars with the CPI-U ratio and use the other sources (2025-2026) as published.
assumptions.national_averages: Every figure is a national average or survey median, not a forecast for one household. The app shows each one as a default the user can change.
assumptions.college_share: By default the family pays 100% of college cost, as a ceiling; scholarships, aid and student loans lower it. The user can change it.
assumptions.child_rearing_scope: USDA costs run from birth through age 17 and leave out college; we treat the child as independent at 18.
assumptions.pet_remaining_life: Remaining life = life expectancy at birth minus current age, with a floor (min_remaining_years in the engine). This is an approximation: we did not extract the by-age tables.
assumptions.parent_care: A parent's care starts when the user says and lasts as many years as the user gives (default: the ACL average). We ignore Medicaid, insurance and the parent's own assets.

child.note: Multipliers from the USDA report's Table 1 footnote.

in_state.notes: Typical = 2026-27 average total student budget before aid (tuition, fees, housing and food, books, transportation, personal). Low = average net cost after grant aid ($21,660). High = sticker budget. Official 2025-26 sticker: $30,990.

out_of_state.notes: 2026-27 average total student budget before aid; no net-price figure found for this sector. Official 2025-26 sticker: $50,920.

private.notes: Typical = 2026-27 average total student budget before aid at private nonprofit four-year colleges. Low = average net cost after grant aid ($38,540). Official 2025-26 sticker: $65,470.

annual.notes: Low and high = Rover's routine annual cost range for dogs. Typical = Rover's lifetime estimate $34,550 / 10 years (our division; lifetime may include one-time costs). Range read from a secondary page; Rover's own page could not be opened.

lifespan.notes: Life expectancy at birth: giant breeds 9.51, all dogs 12.69. High = median survival time 14.13. Rover assumes 10 years.

annual.notes: Low and high = Rover's routine annual cost range for cats. Typical = $32,170 / 16 years (our division). Secondary page for the range.

lifespan.notes: Life expectancy at birth: male cats 10.72, all cats 11.18. High = median survival time 15.7. Rover assumes 16 years.

home_health.notes: Non-medical caregiver (homemaker/home health aide), $35 an hour x 44 hours a week. Scale by actual hours using the override.

assisted_living.notes: Assisted living community, $6,200 a month national median.

nursing_home.notes: Typical and high = private room ($355 a day); low = semi-private room ($315 a day).

duration_years.notes: Low = men's average (2.2), high = 'more than 5 years' (the 20% tail), typical = midpoint of men's 2.2 and women's 3.7 (our arithmetic). Averages across all people needing care, not a forecast for one parent.

wedding.notes: Typical = The Knot average $34,200; low and high = quartile points from a secondary summary. Ceremony and reception only.

divorce.notes: Low = uncontested with lawyers, typical = average legal bill, high = contested to trial. Legal costs only; excludes dividing assets and support.

job_loss_months.notes: Low = median unemployment spell 11.9 weeks, typical = mean 27.1 weeks (both x 12/52). High = 12 months is our illustrative choice for a sabbatical or long search, not a BLS figure. Multiply by the user's income; unemployment benefits ignored.

major_health.notes: ACA 2027 in-network out-of-pocket maximum: self-only $12,000 (low and typical), family $24,000 (high). A ceiling for a bad year, not an average.

home_closing_fraction.notes: Buyer closing costs 2%-5% of price; typical = midpoint (our arithmetic). Moving costs and rent-versus-own are not included.

user_provided_only: Renting versus owning (a comparison, not a default cost)
Child care beyond what USDA includes
Adoption or pet purchase fees (one time)
Sabbatical income beyond months of lost pay
Costs of grandchildren or adult children
